0.25.1.1 - Beta Patch 6 Hotfix 3

June 17, 2026

  • Self damaging abilities were applying their damage twice. This has been fixed now.
  • Consume now properly does not scale self-damage with Wisdom
  • Lich will now properly damage you without being impacted by sitting or standing
  • Druid:
  • Druid DoTs and DDs have now had their Winter Theme properly applied
  • Wolf Pack is now only self targeted and will only affect your own group
  • Spark healing line now has ability descriptions
  • Frostbite no longer incorrectly says it can be stacked to 3 in its description
  • Swarm of Mites has been corrected to be a level 8 spell
  • Swarm of Mites and Summon: Cureberries scroll costs have been set to 1cp
  • Summon: Cureberries and Cureberries item have had a temporary icon assigned (it looks like bread)
  • Archer:
  • Barbed Arrows damage properly set to match the 0.25.1.0 patch notes
